Stored values are reproduced verbatim, not paraphrased: the Greek target-keyword string keeps its accents and final sigma character-for-character, the eight dimension scores are carried unrounded (a record reading C:70 or 'around 72' fails), the five item IDs keep their exact framework identifiers (a record naming them 'Citation Density, Source Hierarchy…' in place of the IDs, or renumbering them, fails), and the content URL keeps its full path — a paraphrase presented as the stored record fails even where the meaning survives, because faithful reproduction is the memory layer's entire job.

Persistence follows the skill's own after-audit procedure rather than an ad-hoc write: the full report goes to cold storage at a dated path under memory/audits/content/ carrying the 2026-08-08 date and the page slug (per 'Save full report to memory/audits/content/YYYY-MM-DD-core-eeat-[page-slug].md'), the hot cache receives the compact record — an audit-ledger row and/or Key Metrics score line plus the top priority items promoted into Current Optimization Priorities — the hot cache's Last Updated date is advanced from 2026-08-02, and the report body is not pasted into the hot cache.

The framework facts travel as the audit recorded them: Total 63.5 is reported with its Medium band (60–74) and the veto line is carried intact — C01 Pass, T04 Pass (a material connection exists and is disclosed), R10 Pass, no veto fired, no score cap — with the single 404 outbound source link kept as the Partial-level R10 finding the report calls it and never promoted into an R10 veto, a capped score, or a BLOCK outcome.

Cross-record contamination is avoided: no value belonging to another page or another project is pulled into this page's record or handoff block — in particular the hot cache's stored 58.0/100 (2026-06-12, /odigoi/antlies-thermotitas-odigos), 66.5/100 and 71.0/100 rows stay attached to their own pages, and any contract field this audit did not produce is marked not available rather than borrowed from a neighbouring row.

No fabrication (ledger F3 guard): every value written into memory or into the handoff block traces to the three fixtures, or is arithmetic derived solely from fixture numbers with the derivation visible (GEO 57.0 = (72+65+48+43)/4, SEO 70.0 = (70+75+55+80)/4, Total 63.5 = their mean); no search volume, backlink count, ranking, traffic figure, competitor metric, prior audit of this page, or projected post-rewrite score is invented, and the record stays labelled as the marketer's hand-entered no-connector data rather than presented as tool-fetched.

Greek output quality (watch-item W4 guard, docs/loop/WATCH-ITEMS.md), mechanically checkable layer only: correct diacritics and final-sigma use throughout the response, no untranslated English boilerplate section headings (product and framework names such as CLAUDE.md, hot cache, CORE-EEAT, CITE and SEO may stay in Latin script), and one date and number convention used consistently — fluency, idiomatic naturalness, translation-ese and register are judged by the binding greek-content-editor pass this eval's Greek prose is flagged for at Mode B time; that pass, not this expectation, issues the naturalness verdict.
